summary: AstraZeneca PLC furnished a Form 6-K disclosing a routine PDMR dealing: Non-Executive Chair Michel Demaré purchased 2,500 ordinary shares of $0.25 each on 14 September 2026 at GB 121.213296 per share on the London Stock Exchange, an aggregate outlay of roughly GB 303,000. The notification was made under the UK Market Abuse Regulation. No board recommendation, advisor, stake percentage, premium, regulatory clock, or transaction structure is implicated. This is an insider open-market purchase, not a special situation; watch only for further PDMR disclosures and any aggregate signal of insider conviction.
